plus_code.compound_code: J8F3+R4 Taiwan, 高雄市新興區玉衡里

reviews.text: The store location was a bit hidden. It is located in a small alley. But the view there is great. The store is quite small and there was quite a long queue, I recommend to go there before the busy time, which is before the office worker got off work. The ramen was delicious, the chicken pieces was so tender, the pork slices was yummy too. Luckily i got there before it was starting to queue. Service can be better.

Probably the best ramen I have ever had. The soup is thick and salty like Japan, noodles and all the ingredients were fresh. They have a lot of meat in one portion, which is surprisingly good, tender and juicy. The fried chicken was crispy,hot and juicy too, with the honey mustard, it is refreshing and not greasy at all!! Highly recommended restaurant

We recently visited this ramen shop and was impressed by the quality of both the pork broth (mushroom) and the spicy flavour options. However, the experience was slightly overshadowed by the excessive wait time - over an hour! This definitely takes away from the overall dining experience and makes it hard to justify waiting that long for a bowl of ramen. I would recommend coming in pairs as there are only two tables available for groups larger than two. For those coming in pairs, it would be way faster than in group. Despite the wait, the ramen itself was delicious and worth a try ONLY if you have the patience!

Ohh so good!

Excellent ramen. Special. Unique. Made with love and respect. Thank you.

I am curious to know if the soup is made with stock, and if so, if the stock is prepared by the restaurant?

The delicious practice of cooking animal meat and bone for prolonged time and then evaporating its water until a very, very concentrated animal stock remains!!

Finally - the employee shirts are so かっこいい!! I wish I could buy one.

This was the best ramen I've eaten thus far in Taiwan!!. I recommend going there sometime between 3 pm and 5 pm to avoid the long wait that is usually outside this establishment. If you're fine with waiting then do you😅.

reviews.text:
To celebrate my friends birthday, we went to Thomas Chien Restaurant for dinner. The food are super tasty and beautiful; and I loved the decoration which is elegant and peaceful. Must come back for lunch and dinner next time.
Reminder: menu changes on Mar, Jun, Sept, Dec. 😍

##The dining time was five years ago, and the review is for reference only##

Thomas Chien is a top-notch French restaurant in Kaohsiung, known for its excellent food, service, and atmosphere. The appetizers were rich and delicate, and the chef's fusion of French and Taiwanese flavors was impressive. The desserts and tea set were satisfying, and the service from staff and cook was exceptional. Overall, the lobster was tender and flavorful, and the shrimp with white wine and caviar sauce was a beautiful and tasty dish. The bread was also noteworthy. In short, if you're in Kaohsiung and looking for an outstanding French meal, Thomas Chien is definitely worth a visit. With every bite, you can taste the chefs' passion for cooking.

Thomas knows how to make impressive dishes. He uses a lot of sustainable concepts to orchestrate the dishes. Overall tasty. Fish and veggies are fine. Beef is well prepared. They can work on service to bring the place to a whole different level.

My friend recommended me Thomas Chien, even I've heard a lot about it since I moved in this city. I went there today to celebrate my partner’s birthday and we do enjoy it very much!

The food was delicious and all tastes very fresh, besides our main dish, we were especially amazed by three entrees. The staffs were very careful and professional The environment is cozy, and you can tell that the experience is carefully designed.

We are happy to bring mom there coz it was her first time to discover French cuisine (à la Taïwanais), and she was very happy about it.

I love every single bites of the delicacies I did not taste before. The waitpeople never show any impatient sign though busyness in the restaurant. With their services, we felt that we were stayed in paradise.

Near the light train station.
Elegant interior design.
Clean environment.
Extraordinary Service.
High price.

reviews.text:
Amazing authentic Indian cuisine. They serve different types of Indian curry, special chicken dishes. The owner of the restaurant was very friendly. They take credit card which is very convenient. Both done in and take out service are provided. The mango yogurt was amazing. The yellow curry with chicken was tasty. Lamb with green curry was little spicy but tastes amazing .
Make sure order the 「plain Naan」
We order food to go, packing of the food was great.
My best favor was the “Chicken Tikka”
We also order the “Chick peas salad “ the sauce was amazing.
The special green curry with lamb has spinach
Great place to taste Indian cuisine when you are in town.
Will definitely come back again.

My FAVORITE Indian place in Kaohsiung!! My friend and I once came here twice in 2 days because we just needed more. Food portions are great, taste is out of this world, and service is very friendly - nothing more to say except that you must come try for yourself!

It’s one of the best Indian restaurants in Taiwan! If you tend to go for the mild version of Indian cuisine, fish curry is recommended. I ordered lamb curry with secret recipe, its flavor is strong and aromatic!

Interestingly, one of the highest rated Indian restaurants in Kaohsiung. And fairly so, their samosas and chicken butter were good. Wish the samosas came with mango chutney but it was great nonetheless!

The beef in the masala was very tender. Not too spicy as we requested, but you can always request for a more spicy dish.

Would say the price is similar to Indian restaurants in Taipei, but I still think you’ll get your money’s worth.

Would definitely be back here if I ever visit Kaohsiung. A solid 4/5 stars!! Recommended!

I was very disappointed with the food taste of this restaurant, as I walked in with very high expectations, seeing is remarkable rating and reviews. The store has nice look and lots of colors. But the food quality is no where close to what it should be. Pani puri, samosa, biryani, lassi, naan all were blend and didn’t have any authentic Indian flavor in them. To me the saving grace was the goat rogan josh, that stood out among all the items we tried. It was nice tender goat meat with some real Indian flavor curry sauce.

Service was pretty good, food came out to the table real fast. But I am not going to recommend this place for Indian food.

reviews.text: A great example of how low Michelin standards are in Taiwan. Low level cooking and execution resulting is no depth of flavor whatsoever. Very little cooking is actually happening. Eel was burnt, proteins were sous-vide and sauces weren’t well made combined with gimics like uni ice cream. Might be ‘good for Kaohsiung’ and it wasn’t disgusting food but to say this is a 1-star restaurant is comical.

Had a really great evening at this restaurant. Good food, nice view over the kitchen, friendly waiters. A bit stingy when it comes to the wine pairing and maybe a bit too fast when delivering the first courses, but all in all a well deserved one star restaurant.
we had an amazing experience at Haili, the staff were friendly and amazing. The food was incredible and fun. overall a great experience that we all said would gladly do again.
Amazing food, Japanese and French cooking. Each dish has a mix of multiple flavours with complexity.
Haili is one of my favorite restaurant in Kaohsiung. The food is original and fresh with great taste. Highly recommended for local and traveling foodies.

reviews.text:
The worst restaurant I’ve been to in a long time.
We arrived — the place was nice and air-conditioned — but the waiter barely understood anything. It took him a very long time to take our order, and by the time he finally did, the kitchen had already closed. That meant we couldn’t order anything else during the meal because he was so slow.

We ordered five portions of fries, which arrived 35 minutes after we had already finished eating our steaks. The steaks themselves were not tasty at all.

The worst part was that the menu had no prices for the steaks, so we asked the waiter, who said they cost between 300–400 TWD. When the bill came, we discovered they actually cost 600 TWD each. After we pointed this out, the manager came over and said they would reduce the price to 400 — but that the waiter would have to pay the difference from his salary.

Why would they even tell us that? Are they trying to make us feel uncomfortable so we’ll just pay the full price? If it was their mistake, they should simply fix it without trying to guilt us into paying.

In conclusion: disgusting food, terrible service, a complete lack of basic understanding — and possibly even an attempt to scam tourists.

Amazed at how efficient this place is.

The food quality is also good, and being able to make beef wellington at the correct doneness and still ensuring the beef is tender and juicy deserves kudos to the team. This dish is not easy to get right, and some upscale restaurants don't even get them right.

The food portion is very generous, and the floor manager does come around to ask if you need more bread.

A palatte cleanser was even served before the main.

The dining experience at this restaurant had its ups and downs. First of all, the drinks are not recommended. Tried two different ones, but neither was satisfying. Surprisingly, the complimentary slushie was much better, with a perfectly balanced sweet and sour taste that was refreshing and helped cleanse the palate. The medium-rare steak had a great texture and was very flavorful. The duck breast had a crispy exterior, with firm and delicious meat.

In addition, the staff were very attentive and kindly reminded us about the birthday month promotion, which enhanced the overall dining experience. The food quality was good, but the drinks could use some improvement.

Came here for a special event and was really impressed with the service and how quickly the food came . This restaurant is located on the second floor. They have a set menu where you can select your soups, salads, meats, dessert and drinks. You can also upgrade your portions for the meats. The presentation of the platters where great and the portions felt just about right. You need to make a reservation for larger groups but not sure if they except walk ins. I have two issues, first is I feel the servers are a bit confused when serving your order. Maybe because we’re a large group? But peoples soup where missing or the served the wrong cooked meat. My other issue is their lack of parking, which isn’t their fault but there really isn’t any or enough. We need to park by the other side of the block. Other than that I would recommend you stop by and give them a try.

A decent set menu, planned carefully. Nice atmosphere and good service.
Food is excellent.

reviews.text:
The good thing was that the basic Thai flavor profile was present. (Many Thai restaurants in Taiwan work so hard to cater to the Taiwanese palate that the food no longer tastes Thai.)

The downsides are, well, everything else.

They are unwilling to serve spicy food to non-Thai customers. We specifically asked for Thai spicy (we checked the Thai language menu box for Thai spicy and requested spicy in Thai language). But nothing was spicy.

The portions are a LOT SMALLER than the pictures. Maybe this isn't the case with the noodle soups, but the roasted meat portions were microscopic. The green vegetables were almost entirely bean sprouts with green vegetables thinly spread on top to look more abundant. And the Thai salad was just tiny. It just wasn't much food for the price!

Regarding price...‼️There is a surprise minimum charge of 150nt per person to eat there. So we ended up spending even more than expected just to be disappointed on the back end.

Overall, just a disappointment. Guess we'll keep looking for good Thai food in Kaohsiung.

This restaurant is a delightful find. So delightful (and delicious) that I came back three times during my visit to Kaohsiung. I went for their richer-tasting version of the boat noodle soup twice on two separate days (yup, there's a light-tasting version for anyone sensitive to spices) and its quality remained the same. I don't think you can go wrong with any dish you choose!

Everything is perfect about this place. The service is on point. They are very generous with their knowledge. Warm and 😊.
They're very helpful and very kind and very happy to be working in this restaurant. Food is beyond simple traditional. They did not adjust the taste for the Taiwanese. The sauces are awesome. Salted egg and rice is incredible. The drinks are top notch and perfectly priced. If I had any complaint, it would be that I don't live close enough to this restaurant to be here everyday!

Great job and see you soon!

The fried pork and thai sauce egg rice are really good, but everything else is not worth ordering. Portions are getting smaller and smaller. I ordered thai milk tea and it came with a mosquito inside (standard beverage shop packaging). I was already out of the restaurant when I discovered the mosquito in my drink, so I wasn’t able to show them.

First time to eat thai cuisine in Taiwan. Not a thai but i went here with my thai friends and we ordered some popular menu. The noodle portion is very huge, so many pork inside. I love the dessert but it's seasonal, only sell in spring.
Fyi, it's not vegetarian friendly. The broth contains pork and there's not much chicken menu.

reviews.text: We walked in without reservation. Lucky, they found a private room for us. The minimum charge was NTD1500. We asked the waitress to recommend dishes and followed her advice. We ordered fish, crab, etc. The foods were very good, the services and environment were excellent. The cooking style is 台灣澎湖style. Highly recomnebdecuf you are coming to 高雄.

Party of 10. We started with assorted very fresh sashimi, followed by fresh penghu abalone, dry sautéed sharsksfin, steamed shrimps, garlic mud crabs, pan fried mackerel, fine hair seaweed with clams, tender sweet gourd saute, rice noodles soup.

Everything was fresh, wonderfully cooked, pacing of the service was perfect, as well as the sequence of tastes and flavors.

For 6 stars seafood, this is definitely the restaurant of choice.

The most amazing dish was the Canadian Uni, which tasted exactly like Murasaki Uni from Japan. Rich & Creamy! We ordered 2 crabs altogether, (Virgin Crab, according to the Menu). Crab Roe, loaded with Omega-3, is abundant in both crabs. Another recommended dish is the Pumpkin porridge, cooked in a broth, containing cabbage and minced pork. Add a bit of spring onions, restaurant peanuts to the porridge, it wraps up an awesome dinner, warming your stomach, esp in winter.

Haitianxia seafood restaurant is the most delicious among the seafood restaurants I have eaten recently.  The lobster and virgin crab are very good!

Peanuts from Penghu are very delicious, and it is a perfect combination with friends who have a drink.  The service is also very fast, I recommend it to everyone~
Getting together with family and friends, the food is amazing, the atmosphere is very nice, highly recommended and will come again 😆

reviews.text:
Beautiful restaurant at in the 10th floor of the hotel. Getting there can be a bit tricky - enter through the department store left side entrance (when facing the main entrance, walk to the left side). There should a winding staircase to the left, which will take to the elevator banks at the lobby.

Food was very good, but the soup dumplings did not have a lot of soup and the wrappers tasted a bit like flour. Prices not terribly high in a nice setting and good service.

The restaurant was michelin grade but was disappointment with the food. The fried rice has a bit of wok hey but was very oily.  The XLB lacked the juicy and tasteful broth that a XLB should have. This restaurant compared to 10 years ago was a totally disappointment. Hotel guest don't have discount as compared to other big hotel.
Better taste and quality than Din Tai Fung. And slightly better cost/value than Din Tai Fung. This place is deserving of its Michelin Star!
Pretty good place. They have a few items that are Michelin considered. The menu gave me an overall din tai Fung vibe but more affordable. Overall pretty solid place and won’t break the bank.

The ultimate "okay" food.

Choose the chicken soup because it was supposedly the michelin star approved food but it just tastes like any regular chicken soup to me. I make better chicken soup.

Xiaolongbao and fried rice was okay too. Nothing exceptional.

reviews.text:
Located next to the Inns Hotel, Beast Bar & Grill has two floors—the first is a bar and restaurant, while the second floor is more of a dining area. I tried several dishes:

• The Chipotle Chicken Quesadilla was delicious—savory with a slight tang, and the portion was generous. The spicy sauce was served on the side.

• The Gyros Fries were also tasty, topped with fries and pork.

• The Caesar Salad was well-balanced, with the dressing just right.

• The Smashburger Deluxe was good, though I think it would’ve been even better if the patty had a hint of sweetness to balance the saltiness.

Overall, the food here was flavorful Tex-Mex, with a salty and tangy profile from the cheese and yogurt. Portions are generous, and the atmosphere is cozy.

Even though it’s a bar, it still feels like a great place for a family to bring the kids—especially on the second floor. If you’re in Kaohsiung and craving Western food, Beast Bar & Grill is definitely worth a visit.
If you have ever had a burger that is somewhat close to decent, you will laugh hysterically at this attempt. The atmosphere is super cool so that is why it is such a shame that the food is terrible.

Absolutely amazing burger place. We were so hungry and saw this driving past so we thought let’s give it a try. Numerous options for burgers as well as Mexican cuisine. Everything was of generous portion and was super tasty. Finally found a place with great Caesar salad dressing. Burgers we super yummy and juicy.

Smashburger was definitely a great choice, which comes with cajun fries.
Decent mood and interior, low level of noise probably because the one being there almost at opening time.

Good place to stop for a quick dinner or getting together with friends. Very casual atmosphere. Not too dark nor too bright lighting. Some dishes may be a bit salty. My smashburger comes with the sauce. A bit salty for my taste. The place also serve Mexican dishes as well...may be next time. So 🌝

reviews.text: Wonderful place! Even for Taiwan, the food is absolutely amazing!! Definitely come here if you are in Kaohsiung. The fried rice was literally the best I ever had. Incredibly friendly staff, I dropped by during lunch break (14:30-16:30, Google isn’t updating the hours) and they served me anyway!

In the journey of anticipating delicious food, although this place is not particularly outstanding in terms of personal taste, it also has its unique charm. These ordinary foods, without gorgeous decorations or amazing tastes, can make us feel a kind of warmth in the ordinary. Perhaps, we can appreciate their simplicity and simplicity, just like the little happiness in life, although not eye-catching, it can trigger a soft satisfaction in the heart. These dishes remind us that the beauty of life is often hidden in those ordinary moments.
Although the service charge was confiscated, the air conditioning on the second floor of the box was not cold at all
The meals were ordinary but not bad, and the most impressive one was the sweet potato with candied silk
The atmosphere was full of stars because it was a family dinner, and it was happy to be together as a family

I have been paying attention to the trends of the hosts before. This time I took a short trip to Kaohsiung and finally tried traditional Taiwanese food. Among them, the scheduled dish was smoked chicken with cane aroma. In addition to the smoky aroma, the meat was not woody at all.

When we went there for dinner that day, we learned that the owner only opens the restaurant based on reservations, so it is recommended to make reservations and order dishes in advance. Some handmade dishes need to be reserved three days in advance because the owner and his father are the only ones running the restaurant. The most recommended handmade dishes are Huadiao pork trotters and crispy pork ribs. The pork trotters are very delicious and smooth, and I quickly cleared the plate without realizing it. The crispy pork ribs are also very delicious and the portion is very large. The taro chicken on the à la carte menu is also highly recommended. It is also a dish with complicated preparation and not easy to taste outside. Through chatting with the owner, I also learned that he has worked in many famous Taiwanese restaurants in the past and has gathered these experiences to create his own taste.

It's absolutely delicious! Authentic traditional flavors!

Every dish we ordered was delicious and affordable. 👍🏻

The owner was so thoughtful and even made the lobster salad for 8 people. The original 12-person portion was completely stuffed with lobster. 🤤

We recommend bringing more people to enjoy more dishes.

reviews.text: Food was decent. Service was good. Overall, good experience.

Fantastic dining experience. If you’re new to this type of experience, let me help you. Make sure you make a reservation and pay the deposit. You will not be ordering from a menu. The chefs will present multiple courses to you and you have the option of adding extra dishes along the way. The food is excellent and the atmosphere is inviting and clean. I highly recommend Midori for a date night!

Opened 8 months ago with a new omakase style dining.  Ours was $1,500 per person.  Unfortunately, it really wasn't worth it.  The sashmi quality was average.  The grilled fish was okay.  The duck meat was cooked in front of us on a small grill which we didn't like because the smoke and smell didn't fit the ambience and they were overcooked.  The giant shrimp came with a gimmick, but it didn't help with the taste, meat was tough and not sweet.  The square sushi was very so so, particularly the one with smoke salmon.  Service was great!

Amazingly tasty! It was my first time having an Omakase experience, and I definitely wouldn’t have wanted it anywhere else. The chef and waitress were very hygienic with COVID precautions, and it was a very pleasant experience.

Can we just all take a minute to appreciate this lovely Japanese place?! ❤️ customized menu that is changed every season! I would love to go back again! The place can only accommodate 10 seats so do reserve in advanced.

reviews.text: I had a truly delightful dining experience here. The food was bursting with flavor — each dish offered a wonderful variety of textures and taste layers that kept surprising my palate. Not only was everything delicious, but the presentation was absolutely beautiful — a true feast for both the eyes and the taste buds. On top of that, the staff was incredibly attentive and friendly, making the entire experience even more enjoyable. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a well-rounded, high-quality meal!

This is a Green Dinning Restaurant. All the ingredients came from Taiwan.
My son is highly recommended so that I can try it.
Various flavor dishes were giving me a surprise.
The dinner time is around two hours.
Must make an advance booking.
A hearty Farm-to-Table lunch and a well curated drinks menu.  Reservation by FB.

It was very good and definitely worth the trip.
Run by a young couple,
Ingredients -
All ingredients, from the alcohol to the oil, are organic.
This is a green restaurant that supports farmers who use environmentally friendly cultivation methods.
Atmosphere - The restaurant has a very relaxing atmosphere, and it feels like you're dining on the beach.
Service - Excellent, with detailed explanations of each ingredient, and the timing of the dishes being served was just right.
Food - A great mix of Japanese and Spanish influences, all made with Taiwanese ingredients.
The flavors were well-balanced, and the unexpected combinations were interesting.
The desserts were both visually and tastefully stunning!
The chef's philosophy and message were clearly conveyed.
This is a restaurant I'll want to return to!

Using local Taiwanese ingredients,
presented in a way that combines the original flavors of the ingredients
Try not to add any additional seasoning

Desserts are also handmade

Each dish will carefully introduce the source of the ingredients and the reason for the combination

The best restaurant in Kaohsiung, no doubt

The best steak I have ever had in Taiwan.  I finally found somewhere to eat steaks in Kaohsiung. Super good food with reasonable prices. Thanks to the restaurant for offering such great food! Highly recommended!  👍👍👍
If you want a good steak, this is your stop. Multiple cuts from many countries and they have beer on tap!
Service was terrible. Finally left after not getting the drink ordered. The idea of only accepting Taiwan Pay is also ridiculous.

reviews.text: The meal was amazing!! Tasty and delicious with the right amount in size. From the soup, salad to the main and dessert. When you are in Kaohsiung and looking for satisfying meals , you should try this place.

As a foreigner I absolutely love this place. Food portion may look smaller than what we're used to in Taiwan to some people, however in my opinion it was very satisfying. You can get one extra refill of rice or soup and the food tastes amazing. The whole place is super cozy and relaxing and the little deserts that come with the tea are delicious and fit the flavor of the oolong tea perfectly! Would recommend to anyone!

I'm not sure it's suited to western palate since the food is quite bland (especially the soup). There is hardly any seasoning or even salt or sugar in anything. It is however very high quality and plentiful - you get a huge set meal at lunch for around 500 TWD.  I enjoyed the Milkfish very much and the atmosphere and service were lovely.
Still, it's relatively expensive, so if you are on a budget you might have to reconsider.
I'd give it 3.5 stars

Very nice dining experience with beautiful Benton box style lunch set.
The sesame slice beef was nice, presentation was beautiful, but the noodle soup was even better.
Very busy, so worth booking.

Family friendly with larger tables in the side room, though no baby chairs but they did have kid utensils. Excellent food that came quickly and very decent portions. A very surprising menu that had a range of favourites that would please everyone in a group. This tea house was recommended to us by our hotel, HOK House, and what a gem of a recommendation it was.

reviews.text: One of the best restaurants in Kaohsiung. The pork hummus was rich, flavorful and garlicky. The seafood was cooked perfectly in the paella. And the rice pudding was creamy but not overly sweet.
Very nice food quality. A bit hard to find restaurant location, but environment inside is very good. Hard to find such quality Spanish restaurant in Kaohsiung.

I was visiting Kaohsiung for 5 days. I have been eating Taiwanese food and McDonald's for about 2 weeks in Taiwan. I wanted a change and had dinner at this Spanish restaurant. I am not an expert on Iberian cuisine. But I enjoyed my dinner at this place. I ordered the meatball tapas and the seafood paella as my main course. The meatballs were tasty and satisfied my meat craving. The Spanish meatballs have a distinct flavor similar to Spanish sausages (I think). I ordered the paella with rice. You can order the paella with noodles instead. The rice was cooked with squid ink which stained my mouth. A drink of water washes the ink down. There is a distinct taste to the squid ink. A few rice grains were a bit hard. I suggest getting the noodles. The noodles might be more moist. I also got a fruity drink. It is good to try something different. But you have to be open to that sort of thing. I would recommend this restaurant. I would visit it again.
Arrived here at 14:15 suppose to be open until 15:00, but was closed already.

It a Spanish restaurant, but when we was trying to order in Spanish, waitresses can’t really understand stand what we want. I’ll say the taste is 4 out of 5, but I think waitress need to be trained if there’s a foreign customer came in, other wise gonna be a problem to order.

reviews.text:
Probably the BEST cocktail bar I’ve ever been to!
Every drink we ordered was on point, and we each had three cocktails — couldn't stop at just one!
The staff gave a short intro for every drink, which made the experience even more fun and thoughtful.
We tried:
調色盤, 經典老回憶, 山梨蜜綠 (super recommended!), 相似的溫柔, Pizza Martini, Triple C
The drinks are creative, well-balanced, and beautifully presented. If you’re ever in Kaohsiung, this is a MUST-VISIT spot!

We’re in Kaohsiung for 6 days and came to Ginmind 3 nights in a row — that’s how much we love it! 🍸 The drinks are like desserts — beautifully crafted, delicious, and full of surprises. The food is just as amazing. Highly recommend the EE-MIAN, LOR BA BENG, beef cheeks, fried cuttlefish fish and stir fry lala!!! All the fried food v nice also. Everyone here is so friendly, kind, and welcoming. Highly recommend to anyone visiting Kaohsiung! Best cocktail bar in kaohsiung. But please reserve a table before coming!!! They are super popular

My favourite night out in Taiwan!

I had been to some wonderful bars during my stay last year, but found many seemed to have a focus on Japanese gins. Although Ki No Bi is wonderful, I was eager to try Taiwanese gins. Gin Mind did not disappoint, with a number of really special local gins, including their own. The owner was passionate and very attentive, and the staff were truly impressive. I was able to get a good understanding of the botanicals and essences, and concepts behind the cocktails and food.

Luckily their English was much better than my Chinese!

The cocktails are delicious and inventive. Aviation was a standout, balancing the sweet, sour, floral and herbal perfectly. Even the cherry was remarkably perfect.

The last thing I remember is the corpse reviver… Then it was the next day.

Luckily hangovers fade, but great gin is forever.
Found this bar by chance, and it was a great end to our night in kaoshiung!
Incredible drinks.  Very unique mix of cocktails.  Not your average bar.  推薦！

reviews.text:
We intentionally saved this spring onion oil pancake spot as our last visit of the trip because we wanted to bring back their frozen pancakes for our friends and family to try. Unfortunately, by the time we arrived around 12 PM, they were already sold out.

Luckily, we still managed to try their classic spring onion oil pancake, along with one pork and one beef xiao long bao. To our surprise, the beef xiao long bao became my favorite—the beef was incredibly juicy and tender, bursting with flavor.

Highly recommend this place to anyone who loves authentic local Taiwanese food. Just be sure to come earlier if you’re hoping to grab their frozen pancakes!

Authentic yummy Taiwanese food. Ordering is quite easy for a tourist, just use Google Translate. They only have 10 or so items in their menu. We enjoyed the scallion pancake and xiaolongbao the most — tho tbh everything was good. Filling lunch! Indoor seating is limited, most people come here to get takeaway.
One of the best scallion pancakes we've came across so far. A must try. The beef roll is good too.
cheap. The scallion biscuit is mid but the xiao long bao is very good.

Very small restaurant with few seat. You should fill the  order form & prepaid, then dishes will be followed.

What a great bar with an amazing vibe! The atmosphere was just right — chill but lively, with good music and friendly people all around. The staff were super welcoming and made sure everything felt easy and relaxed.
And that signature burger? Absolute fire 🔥 — juicy, perfectly cooked, and packed with flavor. Definitely one of the best I’ve had in a long time.
Whether you’re there for a drink, good food, or just to hang out with friends, this place has it all. Can’t wait to go back!

Great place for US and UK travels to unwind in a pub style sports bar. The food is very good, beer on tap is fresh and cold. Just overall a great place....ask for Peggy, she's the best.

We both had the burgers here, beef and chicken, and they were absolutely delicious. Highly recommend this place if you need a break from Taiwanese food for a night. Passion who served us was absolutely wonderful, we were chatting with her many times over the evening.

The food is great and reasonably priced—I especially recommend the burger! The staff is friendly and professional, and the atmosphere is really comfortable. With big screens for watching games, it’s a sports bar I’d definitely visit again.

Everyone sits in their own room so we don't have to eat with others.
Great service and atmosphere.
Love the food. Very unique taste. Every day total different menu. Come in different price range.

The customer service and food here is spectacular. Of course the price is on the higher side, but you’re paying for the overall experience. The plating is beautiful and every dish taste amazing.  This isn’t somewhere I’d go often, but I would recommend here for special occasions.

reviews.text: We came here for lunch. Lunch choices are not many, but taste is good (especially German pork knuckle) and price is not high. Food delivery is quite slow, sometimes we need to wait 10-20 minutes for our next meal. View is stunning, we can see ferries, buildings, blue sky and sea clearly just from our seats. Staffs are not very familiar with meal content, but willing to ask kitchen chef then get back to us. Overall is good.

Came here for their Thanksgiving dinner promotion. They offer the whole turkey or by the plate. We ordered by the plate, but next time we'll order the whole turkey as the server carves it Infront of you. The turkey can easily feed a family of six.
The meal also comes with the all you can eat buffet, drinks and pastries.
Turkey had a good flavor, has tons of different veggies and mashed potatoes. The mashed potatoes where a bit cold. The buffet choices are a bit small but where also good. Plus you get a great view of Kaohsiung.
We're planning to come back on Christmas Eve.
The staff is friendly and helpful.
I see a lot people come and take pictures of the view.
I recommend you give them a try and call and make a reservation before hand.

Good views, nice selection of cocktails, and decent food. You can reserve the table by the windows for two hours. After that, they make you sit somewhere else (even if there is no one else in the restaurant) which was a little disappointing. We would have gladly moved had there been people waiting for the seat.

Staying in the hotel and came here for an afternoon break.  Not a large bistro/cage, but excellent location, on the 30th floor, comfortable seats, overlooking the harbor, great views, especially at night, limited seatings, so make reservations for window seats.  Ordered  fresh made fruit juice and milk tea (min. charge of $150/person in the afternoon), okay tasting.  Good place to take a break in a hot afternoon.

Golden kimchi is also very good and the portion is quite decent for the price. Didn’t like the sushi roll that much. This little shop is cute but it's horrible. We ordered a whole bunch of things because they all looked tasty on Google maps.

Just look at my photos and you'll see that the food looks different. Either the quality tanked or the older pictures were fake. (Not sure if it's visible in the picture but the curry looks nice but it is basically water with a slight hint of coconut and curry)

I ordered the onion tuna roll where the outside and inside are supposed to be tuna but what I got was a roll with tuna on the outside with cheap imitation crab and lettuce on the inside. Furthermore, the chicken ball with cheese looks like shriveled testicles. No I didn't wait until it cooled down before taking the picture. Lastly the curry literally has no flavour. The thin, soft curly udon is in curry SOUP. Not curry.

So horribly disappointed.

reviews.text:
From the very first bite, it’s clear this is no ordinary roast chicken. The skin is perfectly golden, crisped just so, with an aroma that hints at fresh herbs and slow, careful cooking.

The slow rotation of the rotisserie renders the fat gently, basting the chicken in its own juices and remaining  pan juices collected at the bottom like liquid gold drizzling over potatoes, bread, and ratatouille.

The service was good, but the loud techno/ dance music didn’t match the southern France comfort food theme. The decor could feature heavy wood accents like a French farmhouse, especially since chicken is served.

Pls consider expanding a branch to Taipei. An area called Maji Sqaure suits the type of chicken served here.

Oh my freaking gawd! This chicken meal was incredible! The rotisserie out front was begging me to break out a reserve baguette and start dipping it in the roasted potatoes being dripped with chicken juices!
Clearly the place was very busy, and we got lucky they had enough for our takeout order. I saw some negative reviews based mostly on slow service or being hard to reach, but everyone today was very friendly and multilingual - French, English, and Chinese. They recommend reserving your order in advance. If you've ever had chicken and potatoes in France, you will do whatever it takes to get some of this, and there's no way you will complain about having to wait for it.

The "rossiterian chicken ( Poulet Rôtisserie Provençal ) is excellent—a spice-packed chicken that delivers full flavor with every bite. It makes me remember the rossiterian chicken that I had in Les Halles d'Avignon.

The ratatouille, an authentic dish from Nice brought by the owner, is also a highlight. It is even better that I had in Nice!

The one area I suggested to adjust is the baked potatoes; they would be ideal if the skin were grilled to a crisp finish with a soft center.

Best roast chicken in town! Even the sides are delicious. For a family of four, we ordered the 4-person set meal and two chicken burgers...and there were no leftovers! Make sure you book in advance to get a table.

The only Real Rotisserie Poulet in Taiwan!! Awesome and succulent, cooked to perfection, moist tender meat and a skin to die for, full marks!! Gratin dauphinois & Tian provencal very well executed, topped off with delicious beers… strongly recommended, friendly owner and team, superb. Bon Appétit!!

To me, the tea was average only. The toast and the pan cakes were freshly made, so they were the best.

reviews.text:
I have no idea how this restaurant managed to get a 4.4 rating on Google. I decided to visit based on some local suggestions I saw on Threads, but I left deeply disappointed. While the pork bone broth tasted good, with a nice sticky collagen texture released from the bones, the cha siu was a major letdown. Its texture was poor, overly salty, and it wasn’t “fired” as described on the menu. It also lacked the proper balance of fat and lean meat. The ramen eggs were just average — nothing special. Personally, I prefer a richer marinated flavor.

If you’re hungry, I’d say there are definitely better options nearby. And if you’re planning to visit this restaurant — like I did — save yourself the trouble and try a better ramen spot instead.

I know that Taiwanese cuisine has been influenced by Japanese cuisine and as a fan of ramen, I was really excited to try a dish here. This one did not disappoint. The soul of the bowl is definitely its soup. I chose the salty option because I wanted an authentic Japanese flavor. It tasted very similar to the ramen from my favorite shop back home in Vietnam.

I would have been completely satisfied if it had bamboo shoots instead of mung beans, the slices of chashu were a bit more grilled, and the egg had been marinated in soy sauce longer for a richer, more savory taste. However, it was still a great experience. The staff were also very friendly and I heard they spoke Japanese to each other

One of the best bowls of ramen I've eaten in my LIFE! I dined here twice during my short trip to Kaohsiung.

Generous serving of pork slices, with a good mix of fatty and lean meat. Loved the crunch from diced onions. Broth was rich but not too salty. All for a very reasonable price :)

The ramen was so good it was worth the difficulty I had finding it! It is in Formosa station - enter down the escalator via entrance 1. On your left there will be an elevator, turn left and head straight. Then on your left there is a general seating area (not for any specific restaurant and the ramen place is first on the right. The staff were lovely, and there was an English menu that you tick your choices with a whiteboard marker, so very simple to order. My meal came in less than 10 minutes and hit the spot
soup and the thin noodles were great, the down fall off the ramen was the chashu meat, it was dry and lack flavor.  great service from cashier and staff. soft boiled egg was sold out today
